name: Lighthouse Properties p.l.c.
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column from the issuer unaudited condensed consolidated interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, statement of comprehensive income, unit EUR (the statement prints absolute euro amounts). Revenue is the printed total revenue of 77001402. Cost of Sales is the printed property operating expenses of 26182445, the same mapping the annual columns in this file use, so Gross Profit is revenue less that line. Operating Expenses is administrative and other expenses 4630351 plus expected credit losses on tenant receivables 398675 plus depreciation on plant and equipment 26231. The issuer's own printed operating profit is 49269777, which also includes fair value adjustments of 719932, a foreign exchange gain of 178530 and the share of profit of an associate of 2607615; the ten row schema has no line for those three, so EBIT here is gross profit less operating costs and the three items sit between EBIT and profit before tax. 45763700 + 719932 + 178530 + 2607615 - 16436050 + 6568 equals the printed profit before tax 32840295, where 6568 is other income. Net Finance Costs is finance costs 17311793 less finance income 875743. Profit before tax less taxation 947892 equals the printed profit for the period 31892403. EPS is basic 1.51 euro cents converted to euro. Balance sheet ratios are left empty because a half year ratio is not comparable with the annual columns. || CRON 20261023: Lighthouse Properties plc integrated report 2025, group statement of profit or loss, year ended 31 December 2025: profit before tax EUR 93,864,433, taxation EUR 1,369,295, profit for the year EUR 92,495,138 (ties); FY2024 comparative profit for the year EUR 46,305,335 replaces a stored 407,711,380 which the audited statement does not support | CRON 20261025_155306: period columns and blank cells synchronised between the LTE and LTE.JO keys from whichever of the two already held the verified figures (same company name and currency, no value overwritten where the two disagreed); no new figure was collected in this step.
